merchantApiCredentialId.description: Database-only. `identity.merchant_api_credentials.id`; never appears on the wire.

providerAccountCredentialId.description: Database-only. `providers.provider_account_credentials.id`; never appears on the wire.

providerWebhookEndpointId.description: Database-only. `providers.webhook_endpoints.id`, a provider ingress/signature configuration. Never appears on the wire; distinct from `webhookEndpointId` (`whe_`), which is a merchant webhook endpoint.

feePolicyId.description: Database-only. `payments.fee_policies.id`; never appears on the wire.

providerNotificationId.description: Database-only. `providers.provider_notifications.id`; never appears on the wire.

providerEvidenceId.description: Database-only. `providers.provider_evidence.id`; never appears on the wire. Events carry a redacted `redactedEvidenceRef` string, not this identifier.

ledgerId.description: Database-only. `ledger.ledgers.id`; never appears on the wire.

ledgerAccountId.description: Database-only. `ledger.accounts.id`; never appears on the wire.

ledgerCorrectionRequestId.description: Database-only. `ledger.correction_requests.id`; never appears on the wire.
